name: qa_mixer
title: OS-MASTERVOL: Master held + the encoder moves the master volume from any screen (the Pattern screen here), tells the engine (the level on the master drops) and says the value on the strip; the Master tap acts at the release

steps.note: (Shift released, in case a former run left it down)
QA-MIX-030: Master held on Pattern; nothing changes screen
(the unit accelerates a burst of detents: well past the lower end, 0)
QA-MIX-030: still Pattern, the strip says MASTER VOLUME 0%
QA-MIX-030 / 031: the turn consumed the Master tap, so the release did not open the Mixer
QA-MIX-030: the master level is lower on the output
the volume back up, the same way (it is a project value: nothing was saved)
QA-MIX-031: a quick tap of Master; it acts at the release, and is the Mixer
QA-MIX-056 precondition: the unit presents AUDIO (USB AUDIO On) and a Linux computer is on the USB port
(a quick tap of Master is the Mixer)
QA-MIX-056: the STEMS page, OUTPUTS is row 0

steps.say: QA-MIX-056 LINUX ENUMERATION BY HAND, for N in 4, 6, 2, 8, 10 in turn: on the unit, STEMS, the cursor on OUTPUTS, turn to N (the row shows N*), F6 twice (USB WILL RECONNECT: PRESS AGAIN, then the port re-enumerates). On the computer: arecord -l lists the card, then arecord -D hw:<card> -c N -f S16_LE -r 44100 -d 3 x.wav succeeds and has N channels, and one duplex run (arecord and aplay together) works for N up to 8 with USB RETURN On. Console cross-check after each: usb audio says profile and (N ch). Repeat once with Config > USB > USB RETURN Off: no playback device at any N. Record the card line and the channel count of each in the report.

steps.note: QA-MIX-056: the profile after the last apply (the channel count is the one the computer saw)
(back to the default layout, 8 OUT / 2 IN)

finally.note: (a Master left down by a failed run is let go)
(a Song left down by a failed run is let go)
